models.title: Models for translation
models.desc: API keys are encrypted in this computer's OS keychain. They are never sent to our servers.
models.envKeyHint: Using a key from environment variables. A key entered here takes precedence.
models.ollamaModelsUnknown: Run a connection test to list installed models

models.cliLoginHint: The `{{cli}}` CLI is installed but not signed in. Run `{{cmd}}` in a terminal, finish signing in there, then re-check.
models.cliLoginHintNoCmd: This CLI is installed but not signed in. Sign in with it, then re-check.
models.cliMissingHint: The `{{cli}}` command is not on this computer. Install it first — there is nothing to sign in to yet — then re-check.
models.cliMissingHintNoName: This provider's CLI is not on this computer. Install it first, then re-check.
models.cliKeyringHint: This CLI keeps its sign-in in your operating system's keyring, so we cannot read it from here — you may already be signed in. Press re-check to try a real request; if it fails, run `{{cmd}}` to sign in.
models.cliKeyringHintNoCmd: This CLI keeps its sign-in in your operating system's keyring, so we cannot read it from here. Press re-check to try a real request.
models.cliBlocked: Signed in, but not usable yet: {{reason}}
models.cliBlockedUnknown: Signed in, but this subscription cannot serve a request yet. The CLI did not say why — run it in a terminal to see what it reports.
models.cliDisabledHint: The Claude Code connection is currently unavailable. Please choose another provider.
models.cliTestFailUnknown: the CLI gave no readable reason — run it in a terminal to see what it reports.
